headline: Trading Venues Flip To A 53.3 Million Dollar Intake From A 125.8 Million Dollar Outflow
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, flipped to a 53.3 million dollar net intake, 0.0195 percent of custodied value, from a 125.8 million dollar net outflow and 0.0461 percent on the prior print, which means dollars arrived on the venues where holders can sell after they had been leaving. Binance took in 104.6 million dollars, up from 69.5 million dollars, which means more dollars arrived on the largest venue where holders can sell, while Bitstamp sent out 90.0 million dollars, compared with 81.2 million dollars on the prior print. Bitfinex took in 43.1 million dollars over the same window, which means dollars arrived on that venue where holders can sell even as Bitstamp sent more dollars out.
author: jordan
